# GenLy AI

> GenLy AI is a web application for creating lyric videos with generative visual direction.

Canonical website: https://app.genly.pro/

## What GenLy does

GenLy turns an MP3 or WAV song into a lyric video workflow. It transcribes and synchronizes lyrics, lets the user correct text and timing, builds an AI-generated visual direction, and produces a Full HD 16:9 lyric video, a 30-second vertical Short, and a JPG thumbnail.

## Visual direction system

GenLy is not a library of closed video templates. Users can direct the result through three real modes: Auto, Inspired by lyrics, or a custom prompt. The current product includes controls for musical genre, 15 visual concepts, background motion, color palette, custom colors, visual effects, typography, lyrics animation, and transitions.

The Inspired by lyrics mode uses the lyrics to determine the visual subject while the selected concept determines the aesthetic language. A custom prompt can be followed literally or enriched by the system.

## Editing and review

Users can edit lyrics text and timing in a timeline, preview synchronization, configure typography and animation, generate visual variants while keeping the audio and lyrics, and review work from the history screen.

## Multi-scene

The optional multi-scene mode organizes visual scenes around song sections, uses a shared visual identity, and allows individual scenes to be reviewed or regenerated. Multi-scene consumes additional credits.

## Current limits and qualified features

- The creation wizard currently accepts batches of up to five MP3 or WAV files.
- ProRes, broadcast delivery, and Google Drive are available only for enabled accounts.
- Standard output includes a Full HD lyric video, vertical Short, and thumbnail.
- GenLy does not claim guaranteed render times, perfect synchronization, or universal Content ID immunity.

## Intended users

GenLy is designed for artists, producers, content teams, and music labels that want generative visuals without giving up creative review and control.
